Native transform multiplication and positions need admitted finite recipe scale; no current extreme asset witness.

Finite curated byte palettes normalize by510 and positive nonzero authored reference linear channels before component tint division. Surface tile scales use actual named physical tile constants, no arbitrary zero tile caller used. Eight appearance records each allocate distinct infill handle along with timber/tile, so GPU prototype grouping on infill uniquely determines appearance palette in actual resource producer. No arbitrary material UV/shear equivalence claim; authored building surface UV is diagonal scale. Explicit nominal glass thickness preserved rather than packed red-channel inference. Whole fixtures personally read, not run.

Distance min across active cameras uses fixed48/60 load/release hysteresis; no camera yieldsMAX causing lettering release, intentional. Selected supported mount fallback explicitly changes authored requested mount to actual available site; no compatibility API inferred.

Queue visits each outstanding placement at most once per pass, pushes pending assets back, discards failed placement and retains first explicit failure. completed=total-remaining counts failures as processed, confirmed existing fixture; do not reinterpret as successful-building count. finished permits partial city publication with failure report by design. Timing budget64ms bounds work between complete synchronous building spawns, not individual spawn runtime. Reprioritization uses squared distance to native camera and total_cmp, no invalid camera admission here; no normal-scale ordering error. Spawn queues transform+GPUplacement only after compiled recipe succeeds; native elevation addition lacks final admission but extreme producer proof absent. Final queue completion releases temporary CPU recipes/facades intentionally.
